title: POISE: Curvature-Aware Critic Regularization for Smooth Actor-Critic Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.31835v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Actor-critic methods achieve high returns in robotic control, yet trained actors exhibit high-frequency action oscillations. Most smoothness methods constrain the actor, whereas PAVE regularizes the critic by separately penalizing action-gradient variation and encouraging negative action curvature. The same gradient change, however, moves the critic's preferred action farther where the critic is flat, and separate penalties do not measure this motion. We characterize this motion through the greedy shift, which approximates greedy-action displacement across state transitions to first order under local concavity. Since displacement alone does not reflect its critic-value consequences, the analysis further shows that the shift's curvature-weighted energy approximates the value lost by retaining the previous greedy action to second order. Based on this relationship, POISE regularizes the curvature-weighted energy along temporal and spatial

translated_title: POISE：面向平滑Actor-Critic控制的曲率感知Critic正则化
translated_abstract: Actor-critic（演员-评论家）方法在机器人控制中能够获得高回报，但训练出的演员策略常表现出高频动作振荡。大多数平滑性方法直接约束演员，而 PAVE 则通过分别惩罚动作梯度变化并鼓励负的动作曲率来正则化评论家。然而，相同的梯度变化在评论家较为平坦的区域会将其偏好动作移动得更远，而分离的惩罚项无法衡量这种移动。我们通过“贪心偏移”来刻画这种移动，它在局部凹性条件下以一阶近似估计状态转移间贪心动作的位移。由于位移本身无法反映其对评论家价值的影响，分析进一步表明，该偏移的曲率加权能量以二阶近似了保留先前贪心动作所损失的价值。基于这一关系，POISE 沿时间与空间维度对曲率加权能量进行正则化。
tldr: 提出 POISE 方法，通过曲率加权的贪心偏移能量（以二阶近似保留先前贪心动作的价值损失）对 critic 进行正则化，从而有效抑制 Actor-Critic 控制中的高频动作振荡。
en_tdlr: POISE regularizes the critic with curvature-weighted greedy-shift energy, which second-order approximates the value lost from retaining previous greedy actions, effectively suppressing high-frequency action oscillations in actor-critic control.
